title: Fundstrat Capital Announces Monthly Distribution for the Fundstrat Granny Shots US Large Cap & Income ETF (NYSE: GRNI)
author: Fundstrat Capital
description: Fundstrat Capital has declared a monthly distribution of $0.1595 per share for the Fundstrat Granny Shots US Large Cap & Income ETF (GRNI), with an ex-dividend date of March 30, 2026 and payment date of March 31, 2026. The distribution is estimated to be 100% income with no return of capital.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The ETF is actively distributing monthly income to shareholders, demonstrating consistent dividend payments and operational execution. The fund employs an actively managed options overlay strategy designed to generate income while maintaining equity exposure, which is a positive indicator of fund management capability.

GRNY is mentioned as the underlying equity holdings component paired with GRNI's options overlay. No specific performance data or distribution information is provided, warranting a neutral assessment.
